# OptimalRepresentations

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Encoding schemes that maximize information content per unit resource (e.g., energy, time, or neurons) while preserving computational fidelity. Guides the design of in-network neuromorphic systems that need to balance computational power with energy and bandwidth constraints.
